name: Angel, Guiding Light
body:
Guiding Light Angel CR 2

XP 600
NG Small outsider (angel, extraplanar, good)
Init +4; Senses darkvision 60 ft., detect evil, low-light vision; Perception +10
Aura lesser protective aura

OFFENSE

AC 15, touch 11, flat-footed 15 (+4 natural, +1 size, +2 deflect vs. evil)
hp 11 (2d10)
Fort +3, Ref +3, Will +0; +4 vs. poison, +2 resistance vs. evil
DR 5/evil; Immune acid, cold, and petrification; Resist electricity 5, fire 5

OFFENSE

Speed fly 60 ft. (perfect)
Ranged 2 light rays +3 ranged touch (1d6)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 3rd; concentration +4)

Constant–detect evil
At will–continual flame, lesser good hope, greater teleport (self plus 50 lbs. of objects only)

STATISTICS

Str 1, Dex 11, Con 10, Int 6, Wis 11, Cha 12
Base Attack +2; CMB -4; CMD 6
Feats Improved Initiative
Skills Diplomacy +6, Fly +14, Knowledge (planes) +3, Perception +4, Sense Motive +5
Languages Celestial, Draconic, Infernal; truespeech
SQ guiding light

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Guiding Light (Ex)

A guiding light is always exuding a light equivalent to a hooded lantern regardless of form. This light’s color depends upon the patron of the guiding light.

Lesser Protective Aura (Su)

A guiding light has a lesser form of the protective aura possessed by more powerful angels. This protective aura grants the guiding light a +2 deflection bonus to its AC against evil foes, and a +2 resistance bonus on all saving throws made against evil effects or spells cast by evil creatures. This aura extends to a radius of 5 feet, but can only benefit one additional creature other than the guiding light at any one time. A guiding light’s protective aura is fragile, and as soon as an evil creature successfully strikes the guiding light, or as soon as it fails a saving throw against an evil source, its protective aura fades away and is no longer applicable. The guiding light can reactivate its protective aura by spending 1 minute concentrating upon the task.

Light Rays (Su)

A guiding light angel can fire beams of light to damage foes. These light rays have a maximum range of 30 feet.

This attack overcomes damage reduction of any type.

ECOLOGY

Environment any good-aligned plane
Organization solitary, pair, or comfort (3-6)
Treasure standard

Shedding a warm and calming light, this creature appears as a fine lantern kept aloft by white bird-like wings.

Guiding lights are a very minor angel that serve as messengers similar to cassisian angels. However, unlike cassisians, guiding lights are not used by powerful angels to deliver messages, instead they act as messengers to aid those who are downtrodden deliver messages of hope or to foment a resistance against oppressors. Occasionally, they are bound to good mortals to serve as familiars, acting as guides and moral support, spreading messages of hope and community action.

Familiar

A 7th-level good-aligned spellcaster with the Improved Familiar feat can select a guiding light as a familiar.

A guiding light’s true form is a winged lantern that lets out a light that fills one with warmth and hope. The nature of the lantern, wings or light color varies based on the deity they are associated with. The most common variation serves Kaliel, is a brass lantern with white wings and a soft golden-white glow. The guiding lights can assume other forms (that of commoners bearing lanterns, a songbird, or a kindly dog), they find it strange and rarely stay in that form for more than a few minutes.

Typically formed from those that gave their lives to help or defend others, they may also spontaneously arise from a greater angel that falls in such a circumstance. In many cases, the guiding light retains some memory of its previous life. Unfortunately, the memories are more of an encyclopedic remembrance than a true memory and as such do not retain feelings for those they knew in life aside from those in their angelic nature.
